title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Pregnancy: An American College of Chest Physicians Clinical Practice Guideline
organization_or_journal: CHEST / American College of Chest Physicians
authors_when_relevant: American College of Chest Physicians guideline panel
reviewed_summary: Pregnancy-specific clinical practice guidance addressing screening, diagnosis, PAP treatment, reassessment, and the limits of the available evidence.
important_limitations: Pregnancy-specific evidence remains limited; individual care decisions belong to the clinical team.

title: Society of Anesthesia and Sleep Medicine and Society for Obstetric Anesthesia and Perinatology Consensus Guideline on the Screening, Diagnosis, and Treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Pregnancy
authors_when_relevant: SASM and SOAP consensus guideline panel
reviewed_summary: Pregnancy-specific consensus guidance for screening, diagnosis, and treatment context, with clinical judgment required for individual appropriateness.
important_limitations: Consensus guidance is not an individualized treatment order; clinicians determine appropriateness.

title: Treatment of Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea with Positive Airway Pressure: An American Academy of Sleep Medicine Clinical Practice Guideline
organization_or_journal: Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine / American Academy of Sleep Medicine
reviewed_summary: Adult OSA PAP guidance supports clinician-directed PAP treatment with education, follow-up, monitoring, and troubleshooting; it does not authorize the app to select an individual's settings.
important_limitations: Adult OSA guidance is not a substitute for individual clinical assessment.

title: Sleep Apnea - Causes and Risk Factors
organization_or_journal: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
reviewed_summary: Plain-language NHLBI education explains that obstructive sleep apnea involves the upper airway becoming blocked or narrowed during sleep.
important_limitations: Patient education does not diagnose an individual.

title: Apnea del sueño - Causas y factores de riesgo
organization_or_journal: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
reviewed_summary: La información educativa del NHLBI explica en español que la apnea obstructiva del sueño ocurre cuando la vía respiratoria superior se estrecha o se bloquea durante el sueño.
important_limitations: La educación para pacientes no diagnostica a una persona.

title: Sleep Apnea - Treatment
organization_or_journal: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
reviewed_summary: NHLBI patient education describes PAP options and common comfort or side-effect topics while leaving device choice and treatment decisions to the provider.
important_limitations: The page is general education, not an individualized treatment plan.

title: Apnea del sueño - Tratamiento
organization_or_journal: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
reviewed_summary: La educación del NHLBI en español describe el tratamiento con PAP y los temas de comodidad sin convertirlos en instrucciones individualizadas.
important_limitations: La página ofrece educación general y no un plan de tratamiento individual.

title: CPAP
organization_or_journal: National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute
reviewed_summary: NHLBI CPAP education supports general explanations of equipment, mask use, and comfort questions that can be discussed with the care team.
important_limitations: Equipment advice must be individualized by the care team.

title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea
reviewed_summary: AASM patient education describes OSA and explains that the apnea-hypopnea index is the average number of apneas and hypopneas per hour of sleep; the measure does not diagnose an individual without clinical evaluation.
important_limitations: AHI is a general sleep-study measure and should not be interpreted as an individual diagnosis or treatment decision in chat.

title: When to Call 911
reviewed_summary: AHA emergency guidance supports calling 911 immediately for severe chest pain, difficulty breathing, unconsciousness, or another clearly urgent emergency presentation.
important_limitations: The app must escalate and must not diagnose the cause.

title: Warning Signs of a Heart Attack
reviewed_summary: AHA warning-sign education supports urgent escalation for chest-pain presentations and provides English and Spanish emergency-language references.
important_limitations: The app must not delay emergency care with assessment questions.
